summary: Cas wakes in a studio apartment, probably Arthur's or Rio's, with an IV in his hand after a violent escape. Arthur explains that Rio took out the troops and held Dawna Polk hostage, then they traded her to get away. Cas refuses to explain his history with Rio, and Rio enters, noting the rain and making Cas wonder how long he was unconscious.
one_line: Cas wakes in an apartment after an escape in which Rio seized Dawna Polk, and Arthur questions Cas about Rio.
key_facts: Cas wakes in a spacious studio apartment he does not recognize, which must belong to Arthur or Rio.
An IV stand stands beside Cas's bed, with a catheter taped into the back of his hand.
Someone slept on a pillow and blanket on the floor close enough to watch over Cas, probably Arthur.
Arthur says Rio took out the troops and took Dawna Polk hostage.
Arthur says Dawna Polk is valuable enough that they managed to swing a trade to get out.
Arthur says only a handful of people can do the mental jazz, and the troops did not want to lose Dawna Polk.
Cas suggests Dawna Polk is one of Pithica's higher-ups, and Arthur answers yes, sounding unsure and unhappy.
Cas says Rio is not his friend when Arthur asks about it.
Cas refuses to tell Arthur how Rio and he met, saying it is not Arthur's to know.
Rio enters wearing his customary tan duster, with water slicked across the mantle in dark patches.
Cas notes the rainy season in Los Angeles usually starts in December or January, though sometimes it begins months earlier.
Rio greets Cas with 'Hello, Cas' and asks how he is feeling.
Cas answers that he feels like he has been shot.
Cas tells Rio he is getting better and feels more energetic and awake.
Earlier, Arthur had hurried off to make Cas some soup before Cas fell back asleep.
